# Stop Asking. Start Delegating. {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Brief the AI like a direct report

## The Paradigm Shift {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="shift" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
Stop **chatting**. Start **delegating**.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 1em;"}
You don't need a "chat bot". You need a **direct report** — someone you brief properly,
then trust to deliver.
:::

# RICE {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The 4 pillars of delegation

## The Framework {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="rice" style="font-size: 1.1em;"}

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**R — Role:** Who should the AI be?
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**I — Instructions:** What exactly should it do? (format, length, tone)
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**C — Context:** What information does it need?
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**E — Examples:** Show it what "good" looks like.
:::

:::

## R — Role {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="pillar" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3em;"}
**Who** should the AI be?
:::

. . .

Name the expert you'd hire for this job. The role shapes the AI's **vocabulary,
perspective, and priorities** before it writes a single word.

## I — Instructions {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="pillar" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3em;"}
**What** exactly should it do?
:::

. . .

Be specific — bundle the task **with** its format, length, and tone.

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## Pro move
Add: "If anything is unclear, **ask me before you write**."
:::

## C — Context {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="pillar" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3em;"}
**What** information does it need?
:::

. . .

The "brain dump" — paste your notes, upload your docs, give it the raw material.

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## This is the *same* context from the two layers
You are loading the pages onto the brain's desk. **No context = the brain guesses.**
:::

## E — Examples {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="pillar" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3em;"}
**Show** it what "good" looks like.
:::

. . .

Don't just *describe* the output you want — **paste one sample**. The AI copies its
structure, tone, and length.

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## One example beats a paragraph
A single sample teaches more than ten lines of rules.
:::

## The Formula {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #625D9C)"}

::: {style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.05em;"}
"Act as a **[Role]**. Your job is to **[Instructions]**. Here is the **[Context]**.
Match this **[Example]**."
:::
